messages:
Maya: Heads up — customer X is forecasting a 3x spike in inference traffic starting May 12. We need a capacity forecast + ask to procurement for Q2 GPU commitments by EOD tomorrow. Can someone own?
Alex: assigned. I'll pull current queued requests and projected lead times.
Sam: do we have model version + perf profile for their workloads? that affects GPU type (A100 vs H100).
Maya: yes — they run mix of 8k token chat + long-context retrieval; perf shows H100-best but A100-llm-optimized is acceptable at 2.2x cost savings.
Alex: quick note — current procurement lead for new H100 reserved pools is 6-8 weeks in us-west1. A100 reserved has 2-3 week lead. Region constraints might force cross-region placement.
Liz: SRE: if we spill to us-central we'll incur 7–15ms added p99 for that customer and egress cost if data crosses VPC. need approval from customer for cross-region failover.
Maya: can we do hybrid: commit to A100 reserved for baseline, and short-term burst on spot/H100 for peak? cost/billing tradeoffs?
Ana (Finance): cost perspective: hybrid commit reduces committed spend but increases variable cost. we can draft two scenarios (A: 6-month A100 commitment + spot H100 bursts, B: full H100 commit) and show net burn and unit $/token.
Alex: I'll generate the scenarios. pulling queued reservation CSV now.
Alex: ```
# get queued gpu requests
cat /opt/procurement/queue/gpu_requests.csv | awk -F, '{print $1,$3,$5}' | sort -k3n
```
Alex: current queue has 42 pending requests, 9 marked high-priority, 3 blocking customer launches this month.
Sam: Also flagging that model quantization gives ~1.8x throughput on A100 for this particular model; might reduce required GPU count if we push quantization pipeline.
Maya: Sam can you estimate effort to enable that quant path? even a 2-week work could change procurement ask.
Sam: estimate 3-4 engineer-weeks + 1 week validation. can fast-track if we pause noncritical infra work.
Ana (Finance): can procurement do partial commit with monthly true-ups? would reduce risk for finance.
Alex: Procurement says partial commitments available but minimum commitment units are large. I'll loop in ProcureOps.
ops-bot: @alex updated queue status: 42 items, high-priority=9, blocked=3. Link: https://internal.ops/queue/1769992222
Maya: OK plan: Alex + Sam pair on scenarios today; Ana please prepare financial scenarios for both A and B; Liz prepare impacted-region SLO note. We'll sync 2pm PT.
Liz: noted — will include p99 latency delta and egress delta.
Ana (Finance): will have draft by 1:30p.
Alex: starting now. tagging @procureops for escalation if needed.
Maya: thanks team :thumbsup:
